The '''Tund system''',<ref name="MoS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> also known as the '''Toong system''',<ref name="ItWoSW:EPI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tund/Legends|Tund]].
